analysis:
Examined MTPUpgrade head L127 and ModelLoading head L397/L434. Both add transitionGenerations.begin(.modelLoading) after isLoadingAny=true. ModelLoading L207 swaps autopilotAllowsModel for autopilotServesModel in the load-selection gate; the explicit command-id bypass is unchanged. Unload (~L1166) now calls reconcileAutopilotPlacements() after slot removal. evictableModelSlots (~L1316-1324) excludes Autopilot-held models via autopilotHoldsModel(now:).

These are local availability and placement-lifecycle changes. They do not touch encryption, attestation (TB-009/TB-011), weight-hash publication (T-012/T-027), SSD cache keying (T-041) or credentials. The weight-hash capture/publish and markWeightHashUnavailable paths are unchanged.

Open questions for integration, since the implementations are not supplied:
(1) Whether autopilotServesModel is at least as strict as autopilotAllowsModel, or whether it can admit loads of models that are not selected.
(2) Whether transitionGenerations.begin has a matching end or completion on every early-throw path. Examples are the slot-cap throws near L409-426 in base and the MTP insufficientMemory throw at head L137. A leaked generation could stall routing or evidence generations (availability; cf. T-053 generation semantics).
(3) Whether autopilotHoldsModel holds can pin memory indefinitely (DoS, T-029-like).
(4) Whether reconcileAutopilotPlacements is synchronous and safe while called mid-unload.

No concrete regression is evidenced in the visible source.
